video_list.caption: How to write a research paper like a phd/master student!!!
video_list.transcript: How to write your thesis paper like a PhD/Master student. Just go to this website. Click researcher. Type your research paper topic. Use latex for PDFs. Then watch it do its magic in 2-3 mins. A complete research paper with meaningful visualizations.
video_list.frames_summary: Handheld Google Scholar page, product website reveal, researcher mode, topic input, generated research paper pages, charts and visualizations.
